detail.note: Search box and zoom/pan controls are groundable via the normal DOM interactive listing — expected, they are real DOM elements. The map surface itself is a <canvas>: opaque to DOM-based grounding by construction, same as every DOM-reading tool (Playwright/Puppeteer included). No attempt was made to read canvas pixel content — out of scope, matches successCriteria.

detail.signalUsed: the `download` CLI command's own real completion signal (added Phase 4) — no longer polling the filesystem by diff.
